common_intent_requirements.text: 预热过的平底锅里放一小片薄黄油
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 预热过的平底锅里放一小片薄黄油
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a close view looks into a preheated frying pan, holding a steady composition that clearly shows the pan bottom. A small, thin slice of butter is placed onto the hot surface.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍它受热后逐渐变软、融化并摊开
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍它受热后逐渐变软、融化并摊开
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Keep the same slice in view as the contact edge softens and a yellow liquid margin appears around it. The remaining solid gradually becomes smaller and softer while melted butter spreads outward along the pan bottom.
a close view looks into a preheated frying pan, holding a steady composition that clearly shows the pan bottom.

physics_checks.criterion: 固态黄油向液态油脂的变化连续且与热锅接触相容。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 边缘变软、液态油脂出现并摊开，残余固体可见缩小趋势。
fail_examples: 没有液体形成却整片凭空消失
固体黄油直接变成不相关物体
液态部分向空中无支撑上升
not_required: 不要求十秒内完全融尽
允许细泡、残留固体和非均匀融化

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
